claims.text: The installed backend unit executes the production entry point (create_app factory on port 8001) under the name glossa-lab-backend, matching what the tray controls.
falsification_tests: A rendered unit containing shell.sh, --reload, port 8000, or a unit name other than glossa-lab-backend.

evidence.description: services/linux/glossa-lab-backend.service template + render assertions in backend/tests/test_supervision_installer.py; tray main.py start/stop target the same unit name.

claims.text: Restarts are capped at 3 starts per hour and cap/failure records an OWNER NEEDED marker via the alert unit.
falsification_tests: A unit without a start limit or OnFailure target, or an alert path that restarts the backend instead of recording the alert.

evidence.description: StartLimitBurst=3 / StartLimitIntervalSec=3600 / OnFailure=glossa-lab-backend-alert.service in the unit; record-owner-needed.sh writes OWNER_NEEDED + supervisor.log.

claims.text: One idempotent installer installs backend unit, tray autostart, and icon in a single run, and retires the legacy unit.
falsification_tests: An install run that leaves the legacy unit enabled, or a second run that changes rendered files.

evidence.description: services/linux/install.sh (render-only test asserts unit, alert, support scripts, desktop entry, and byte-identical icon); legacy glossa-lab.service removal in the service-manager step.

claims.text: Install/start verification checks backend identity, not liveness alone.
falsification_tests: A verification path that passes when a different application answers on the port, or an unbounded wait.

evidence.description: services/linux/healthcheck.py requires /docs 200, health status+version, and openapi title 'Glossa Lab' with matching version; unit tests cover accept and reject cases; installer runs it after start with bounded attempts.

claims.text: The tray icon is the Glossa Lab brand tile (frontend mark: #2563eb to #60a5fa gradient, white G) with a status badge, in PNG/ICO/SVG packaged assets.
falsification_tests: A tray build whose icon is a plain coloured circle, the BitConcepts mark, or any other project's logo.

evidence.description: tray/glossa_tray/assets/{glossa-lab.svg,glossa-lab.png,glossa-lab.ico} built by build_icon.py from the frontend tile spec; PNG sha256 recorded in the change record; tray pixel test asserts brand-blue corner + badge.

claims.text: After live cutover, exactly one supervisor owns the VM backend: systemd (system mode); the cron watchdog keeps history but no restart duty.
falsification_tests: A post-cutover state where the watchdog can still start the backend, or the backend runs outside the systemd unit.

evidence.description: Cutover record: systemctl status + kill/restart check on the VM; watchdog cron file annotated with restart duty stood down and its prompt changed to report-only.

claims.text: The backend unit lowers the backend's OOM kill priority with OOMScoreAdjust=-300, addressing the verified root cause of the 2026-10-27 deaths (kernel OOM kills at adj 0, oom_score 674, log stopping mid-stream with no shutdown lines).
falsification_tests: A rendered unit without OOMScoreAdjust, a value at or below -700 (daemon territory), or a live backend process whose oom_score_adj is still 0 after cutover.

evidence.description: OOMScoreAdjust=-300 in services/linux/glossa-lab-backend.service, asserted by backend/tests/test_supervision_installer.py; post-cutover systemctl show + /proc/<pid>/oom_score_adj read-back on the VM.
